description: This file defines an interface for UCI (Unified Configuration Interface) manipulation within the beerocks namespace, providing functions for managing configuration sections and options, such as checking existence, adding, retrieving, setting, deleting, and committing configuration data.

methods.name: uci_section_exists
methods.description: Checks if a section with a given name exists within a specified package.

methods.name: uci_find_section_by_option
methods.description: Finds a section of a specific type containing an option with a specified value.

methods.name: uci_add_section
methods.description: Adds a new section of a specified type and name to a package, with optional immediate commit.

methods.name: uci_set_section
methods.description: Sets or updates options within a section; options with empty values are removed.

methods.name: uci_get_section
methods.description: Retrieves all options from a specified section.

methods.name: uci_get_section_type
methods.description: Retrieves the type of a section based on its name.

methods.name: uci_get_option
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific option within a section.

methods.name: uci_delete_section
methods.description: Deletes a specified section from a package, with optional immediate commit.

methods.name: uci_get_all_sections
methods.description: Retrieves all sections of a given type within a package.

methods.name: uci_commit_changes
methods.description: Commits any pending changes to a package.
